title: Number of Good Paths
goal: Count tree paths with equal endpoint values and no larger value between them.
strategy: Activate connectivity in increasing value order. After processing one value, nodes of that value sharing a component can be paired; a group of k contributes k singleton paths and k choose two endpoint pairs.
